coffee with sugar vs. coffee without sug: Grandpa drinks his coffee with two spoons of sugar every morning, but Mom always orders coffee without sugar.
爺爺每天早上喝加兩匙糖的咖啡，但媽媽總是點無糖咖啡。
with (伴隨) vs. by (作者): I read a short story with my little sister last night, and it was written by a famous Taiwanese writer.
昨晚我和小妹一起讀了一篇短篇故事，那是由一位台灣知名作家所寫的。
a book with pictures vs. a book by Tom: My cousin gave me a book with beautiful pictures of animals, and my uncle gave me a book by Tom.
我表哥送我一本有美麗動物插圖的書，我叔叔則送我一本湯姆寫的書。
die of (死因) vs. die with (帶著): The old man died of a heart problem at ninety, but he died with a smile and his family around him.
老先生九十歲時死於心臟問題，但他死時帶著微笑，家人圍繞在身邊。
shake with fear (因) vs. shake hands with: The little boy was shaking with fear during the storm, but later he happily shook hands with the brave police officer.
暴風雨期間小男孩怕得發抖，但後來他開心地和勇敢的警察握手。
be with sb. (陪伴) vs. be for sb. (支持): My best friend was with me at the hospital all night, and the whole class was for me when I ran for class leader.
我最好的朋友整晚在醫院陪著我，而當我競選班長時，全班都支持我。
help sb. with (幫忙做) vs. help sb. to V: My brother helps me with my math homework every evening, and sometimes he helps me to clean my room too.
我哥哥每天晚上幫我寫數學作業，有時候也幫我打掃房間。
What's wrong with (非 for): What's wrong with your leg today, because you walked very slowly up the stairs and looked like you were in pain?
你的腿今天怎麼了，因為你上樓梯走得很慢，看起來很痛的樣子？
be good with (擅長應付) vs. be good at (擅長技能: My aunt is good with little children, and she is also good at making them laugh with funny songs.
我阿姨很擅長和小孩子相處，她也很擅長用有趣的歌逗他們笑。
together with (連同) vs. along with: Please bring your notebook together with your pencil case, along with the money for the school trip tomorrow.
請把你的筆記本連同鉛筆盒帶來，還有明天學校旅行的錢。
deal with (處理) vs. deal in (買賣): My mother deals with angry customers at work every day, and my uncle deals in used cars near the station.
我媽媽在工作上每天處理生氣的顧客，我叔叔則在車站附近經營二手車買賣。
do with (處理) vs. do without (沒有也行): I do not know what to do with all these old clothes, but I can do without that broken chair.
我不知道該怎麼處理這些舊衣服，但那張壞掉的椅子我沒有也行。
without a word: After the teacher gave back the test papers, Jack picked up his bag and left the room without a word.
老師發回考卷之後，傑克拿起書包，一句話也不說地離開了教室。
without doubt: Without doubt, this is the best beef noodle shop in our town, and people wait in line for an hour.
無疑地，這是我們鎮上最好的牛肉麵店，人們排隊等一個小時。
without question: Mary is without question the fastest runner in our school, and she wins every race on sports day.
瑪麗毫無疑問是我們學校跑得最快的人，運動會每場比賽她都贏。
without fail: Grandpa walks to the park at six every morning without fail, even when it is cold and windy outside.
爺爺每天早上六點一定走路去公園，即使外面又冷又有風。
without stopping: The little girl talked without stopping for the whole bus ride, and her mother just smiled and listened.
整段公車路程小女孩一直不停地講話，她媽媽只是微笑著聽。
without thinking: When I saw the ball coming toward the baby, I ran and caught it without thinking about my own safety.
當我看到球飛向嬰兒時，我不加思索地跑過去接住它，沒想自己的安全。
without looking: Never cross a busy street without looking, because the cars and scooters come very fast around that corner.
過繁忙的街道時絕對不要沒看就走，因為汽車和機車在那個轉角來得很快。
without end: The rain seemed to go on without end last week, so we stayed inside and played cards every afternoon.
上星期的雨好像無止盡地下，所以我們每天下午都待在室內玩牌。
without a care in the world: The children ran around the beach without a care in the world while their parents cooked dinner.
孩子們無憂無慮地在海灘上跑來跑去，他們的父母則在煮晚餐。
without my help: My little sister finished the hard puzzle without my help, and she was very proud of herself all day.
我妹妹沒有我的幫忙就完成了困難的拼圖，她一整天都很為自己驕傲。
without a doubt: Without a doubt, my grandmother makes the best dumplings in the family, and we all ask for more every time.
毫無疑問，我奶奶包的水餃是家裡最好吃的，我們每次都要再吃。
without notice: The bus times may change without notice, so please check the sign at the stop before you go.
公車時間可能不另行通知就改變，所以出發前請先看看站牌上的告示。
without a break: The students practiced for the dance show for three hours without a break, and everyone was very tired.
學生們為了舞蹈表演不休息地練了三個小時，大家都非常累。
without sleep: My father went without sleep for two nights because the baby kept crying, so he fell asleep at dinner.
因為嬰兒一直哭，我爸爸兩個晚上沒睡覺，所以晚餐時他睡著了。
without a friend: When Amy moved to the new school, she was without a friend for a month, but now she has many.
艾咪轉到新學校時，有一個月沒有朋友，但現在她有很多朋友。
without charge: Children under six can enter the museum without charge, but adults have to pay two hundred dollars.
六歲以下的孩童可以免費進博物館，但大人要付兩百元。
without saying goodbye: Peter left the party without saying goodbye to anyone, so his friends were a little sad and surprised.
彼得沒跟任何人說再見就離開了派對，所以他的朋友有點難過又驚訝。
go without food: The lost dog went without food for three days, so we gave it some rice and chicken when we found it.
那隻走失的狗三天沒東西吃，所以我們找到它時給了它一些飯和雞肉。
do without: We cannot do without water on a hot day like this, so please put two big bottles in the bag.
像這樣的大熱天我們不能沒有水，所以請把兩大瓶水放進袋子裡。
It goes without saying that you should wash your hands before dinner, especially after you played with the dog.
不用說，晚餐前你應該洗手，尤其是在你和狗玩過之後。
leave without paying: The man tried to leave without paying for his noodles, but the shop owner stopped him at the door.
那名男子想沒付麵錢就走，但店老闆在門口攔住了他。
can't live without you: In the movie, the young man told the girl that he can't live without you, and the whole theater laughed.
電影裡，年輕男子對女孩說沒有你我活不下去，整個電影院都笑了。
without so much as a thank you: I carried her heavy bags all the way home, and she walked away without so much as a thank you.
我幫她把重重的袋子一路提回家，她卻連句謝謝都沒有就走了。
be without a job: My uncle has been without a job for six months, so he is learning to cook and wants to open a shop.
我叔叔已經六個月沒有工作，所以他正在學做菜，想開一家店。
not without reason: The teacher chose Lisa as class leader not without reason, because she is kind and always helps others.
老師選麗莎當班長不是沒有原因的，因為她很善良，總是幫助別人。
without a sound: The cat jumped up on the table without a sound and ate the fish before anyone in the kitchen noticed.
那隻貓一聲不響地跳上桌子，在廚房裡任何人注意到之前就把魚吃掉了。
without any trouble: We found the small restaurant without any trouble, because the map on my phone showed us the way.
我們毫無困難地找到了那家小餐廳，因為手機上的地圖指引我們路。
without a second thought: When the old lady dropped her money, the boy picked it up and gave it back without a second thought.
老太太掉了錢的時候，男孩毫不猶豫地撿起來還給她。
without rest: The nurses worked without rest during the busy night, and many sick people thanked them in the morning.
護士們在忙碌的夜裡不休息地工作，早上很多病人向她們道謝。
without number: On a clear night in the mountains, you can see stars without number, and the sky looks like a picture.
在山上晴朗的夜晚，你可以看到無數的星星，天空看起來像一幅畫。
without (沒有, 介係詞 + N/V-ing) vs. not havi: Without saying anything, she handed me the gift, and her face showed how happy she was to see me.
她什麼也沒說就把禮物遞給我，她的臉顯示出見到我有多開心。
without saying a word (非 without say): The old man sat by the window without saying a word, and he watched the rain fall for an hour.
老先生坐在窗邊一句話也不說，看著雨下了一個小時。
without (沒有) vs. with (有): I can drink tea without milk, but I cannot enjoy my morning coffee with no milk in it at all.
茶沒有牛奶我可以喝，但早晨的咖啡裡完全沒有牛奶我就無法享受。
without doubt vs. no doubt: Without doubt, our team will win the game tomorrow, because we have practiced hard every day for a month.
無疑地，我們隊明天會贏得比賽，因為我們一個月來每天都努力練習。
without (缺少) vs. except (排除): Everyone in the class except Tom finished the test, and he could not finish it without more time.
班上除了湯姆每個人都寫完考卷了，而他沒有更多時間就無法完成。
go without (沒有而忍受) vs. do without (沒有也行): Poor families sometimes have to go without meat for weeks, but we can easily do without dessert tonight.
貧窮的家庭有時好幾個星期沒肉可吃也得忍受，但我們今晚沒有甜點也行。
without: He arrived at the airport with no ticket and without his ID card, so he could not get on the plane.
他到機場時沒有機票也沒有身分證，所以他無法上飛機。
with no money: I went to the night market with no money in my pocket, so I just walked around without buying anything.
我去夜市時口袋裡沒錢，所以我只是到處走走，沒買任何東西。
within a week: The doctor said my brother's broken arm will feel much better within a week if he rests at home.
醫生說如果我弟弟在家休息，他骨折的手臂一週內會好很多。
within an hour: If you order the pizza now, the shop will send it to our house within an hour, so let's wait.
如果你現在訂披薩，店家會在一小時內送到我們家，所以我們等等吧。
within the next few days: The teacher will tell us our test scores within the next few days, so please do not worry too much.
老師會在接下來幾天內告訴我們考試成績，所以請不要太擔心。
within minutes: The fire trucks arrived within minutes after the man called for help, and nobody in the building was hurt.
那名男子打電話求救後幾分鐘內消防車就到了，大樓裡沒有人受傷。
within the time limit: You must finish all the questions within the time limit, or the computer will stop the test by itself.
你必須在時限內寫完所有題目，否則電腦會自動停止測驗。
within living memory: Grandpa says this is the biggest storm within living memory, and even the old people in town have never seen one like it.
爺爺說這是記憶所及最大的暴風雨，連鎮上的老人都沒見過這樣的。
within the city: There are more than twenty night markets within the city, so visitors can try different snacks every evening.
市內有超過二十個夜市，所以遊客每天晚上都能嘗試不同的小吃。
within walking distance: Our new apartment is within walking distance of the school, so I do not need to take the bus anymore.
我們的新公寓在走路可到學校的距離內，所以我不再需要搭公車了。
within reach: Keep a bottle of water within reach when you study late at night, so you do not have to get up.
晚上熬夜讀書時，把一瓶水放在伸手可及的地方，這樣你就不必起身。
within sight: Please stay within sight when you play on the beach, because the waves can be very strong today.
在海灘上玩的時候請留在看得見的範圍內，因為今天的海浪可能很強。
within the school: Students are not allowed to use their phones within the school during class time, except for the lunch break.
上課期間學生不可以在校內使用手機，午休時間除外。
within 10 kilometers: There are three hospitals within 10 kilometers of our house, so help is never far away if someone gets sick.
我們家十公里內有三家醫院，所以如果有人生病，幫助永遠不遠。
within the house: It was raining hard outside, so the children stayed within the house and built a castle with the sofa pillows.
外面下著大雨，所以孩子們待在屋內，用沙發的枕頭蓋了一座城堡。
within the limits: Please keep the party noise within the limits, because our neighbors have a baby who goes to bed at eight.
請把派對的噪音控制在限度內，因為我們的鄰居有個八點就睡覺的嬰兒。
stay within the lines: The art teacher asked the little kids to stay within the lines when they colored the pictures of animals.
美術老師要求小朋友們著色動物圖片時不要畫出線外。
within the law: The shop owner always sells his goods within the law, so the police never have any problems with him.
店老闆總是在合法範圍內賣他的商品，所以警察從來沒找過他的麻煩。
within one's power: I will do everything within my power to help you pass the English test, but you must also study hard.
我會盡我能力範圍內的一切幫你通過英文考試，但你也必須用功讀書。
within the rules: You can wear any color of socks, as long as it stays within the rules of our school about clothes.
你可以穿任何顏色的襪子，只要在學校服裝規定的範圍內就好。
live within one's means: My parents taught me to live within my means, so I never spend more money than I have each month.
我爸媽教我量入為出，所以我每個月從不花超過我有的錢。
within reason: Mom lets me stay up late on weekends within reason, but midnight is too late for a student like me.
媽媽讓我週末在合情合理的範圍內晚睡，但對我這樣的學生來說半夜太晚了。
from within: The tree looked healthy outside, but it was slowly getting sick from within because insects had eaten the wood.
這棵樹外表看起來很健康，但因為昆蟲吃了木頭，它正從內部慢慢生病。
a voice from within: When I wanted to give up on the race, a voice from within told me to keep running to the finish line.
當我想在比賽中放棄時，內心有個聲音告訴我要繼續跑到終點。
within oneself: After the long talk with his grandfather, Jason felt a quiet peace within himself for the first time in weeks.
和爺爺長談之後，傑森幾個星期以來第一次在內心感到平靜。
within (之內, 不超過) vs. in (…之後): Please hand in your homework within three days, not in three days, because I need to check it before Friday.
請在三天內交作業，不是三天後，因為我需要在星期五之前檢查。
within an hour (一小時內) vs. in an hour (一小: The doctor will see you within an hour, but the next free doctor only starts work in an hour from now.
醫生會在一小時內看你，但下一位有空的醫生要在一小時後才開始看診。
within (內部) vs. inside: The letter said all students must stay within the school building, so we waited inside the gym until the rain stopped.
信上說所有學生必須留在校舍內，所以我們在體育館裡面等到雨停。
within reach vs. out of reach: Put the cookies within reach of the kids at the party, but keep the knives out of reach on the high shelf.
派對上把餅乾放在孩子拿得到的地方，但刀子要放在高架上他們拿不到的地方。
within (範圍) vs. without (沒有): You can play anywhere within the park, but do not go out the gate without an adult beside you.
你可以在公園範圍之內的任何地方玩，但沒有大人在旁邊不要走出大門。
taller than me: My younger brother is already taller than me, even though he is only twelve years old and still growing.
我弟弟雖然才十二歲還在長高，但已經比我高了。
more than 100: More than 100 students joined the school running club this year, so we had to practice in two groups.
今年有超過一百個學生加入學校的跑步社，所以我們必須分兩組練習。
rather than: On hot summer days, my grandmother likes to drink cold tea rather than coffee, because coffee makes her thirsty.
在炎熱的夏日，奶奶喜歡喝冰茶而不是咖啡，因為咖啡讓她口渴。
other than: Nobody other than my best friend knows about my plan to study music in Japan after high school.
除了我最好的朋友，沒有人知道我高中畢業後要去日本學音樂的計畫。
no other than: The person who left the beautiful flowers on the teacher's desk was no other than the quiet boy in the back row.
把美麗的花放在老師桌上的人正是後排那個安靜的男孩。
less than ten: Fewer than ten tickets are left for the show, so less than ten minutes from now they will all be sold out.
這場表演剩下不到十張票，所以再少於十分鐘它們就會全部賣完。
would rather A than B: On a rainy Sunday, I would rather read a comic book at home than go shopping in the crowded mall.
下雨的星期天，我寧願在家看漫畫而不要去擠滿人的購物中心逛街。
no sooner…than…: No sooner had we sat down for the picnic than it started to rain, so we ran back to the car.
我們一坐下來野餐就開始下雨，所以我們跑回車上。
more often than not: More often than not, my father falls asleep on the sofa while he watches the late night news on TV.
我爸爸通常在看深夜電視新聞時就在沙發上睡著了。
than (比較) vs. then (然後): My sister is taller than my mother now, and then she will probably grow even taller next year.
我姊姊現在比我媽媽高了，然後明年她可能會長得更高。
than (比較) vs. from (不同): This cake is sweeter than the one we had last week, and it also tastes very different from Grandma's cake.
這個蛋糕比我們上星期吃的甜，而且它的味道也和奶奶的蛋糕很不同。
rather than + V/N: My parents always walk to the market rather than drive there, because parking is hard to find on weekends.
我爸媽總是走路去市場而不開車，因為週末很難找到停車位。
more than happy: I would be more than happy to show you around Taipei when you visit Taiwan next summer with your family.
明年夏天你和家人來台灣時，我非常樂意帶你參觀台北。
more than enough: Mom cooked ten dishes for only four people, so there was more than enough food for everyone at dinner.
媽媽只為四個人煮了十道菜，所以晚餐的食物對大家來說綽綽有餘。
nothing more than: Do not worry, that loud noise last night was nothing more than the wind hitting the old windows upstairs.
別擔心，昨晚那個大聲響只不過是風吹打樓上的舊窗戶。
no more than: It takes no more than ten minutes to walk from my house to the train station, so I never leave early.
從我家走到火車站僅僅需要十分鐘，所以我從不早出門。
not more than: The teacher said our story should be not more than two hundred words, so please count your words before Friday.
老師說我們的故事不超過兩百字，所以請在星期五前數一下你的字數。
no less than: No less than fifty people came to my grandmother's birthday party, and the whole street was full of cars.
多達五十個人來參加我奶奶的生日派對，整條街都停滿了車。
not less than: Please drink not less than eight glasses of water a day when the weather is this hot and you play sports.
天氣這麼熱而你又運動時，請一天喝不少於八杯水。
other than that: The hotel room was a little small, but other than that, our trip to the beach was perfect from start to finish.
飯店房間有點小，但除此之外，我們的海邊之旅從頭到尾都很完美。
than ever before: After the new coach came, our basketball team played better than ever before and won the city final.
新教練來了之後，我們的籃球隊打得比以前任何時候都好，還贏了市決賽。
everyone but me: Everyone but me finished the long test early, so I was the only student still writing when the bell rang.
除了我，每個人都提早寫完了這份長考卷，所以鐘響時我是唯一還在寫的學生。
nothing but water: The doctor told my father to drink nothing but water for one day before the health check at the hospital.
醫生告訴我爸爸在醫院健康檢查前一天只能喝水。
anything but easy: Learning to ride a bike was anything but easy for me, because I fell down more than ten times in one afternoon.
學騎腳踏車對我來說一點也不簡單，因為我一個下午跌倒超過十次。
all but one: All but one of the students passed the math test, and the teacher gave that boy extra help after class.
除了一個學生以外，所有人都通過了數學考試，老師下課後給那個男孩額外的幫助。
the last but one: Our team finished the last but one in the race, so only one team was slower than us that day.
我們隊在比賽中跑到倒數第二名，所以那天只有一隊比我們慢。
cannot help but laugh: When the puppy fell asleep in the shoe, we could not help but laugh and take pictures with our phones.
當小狗在鞋子裡睡著時，我們忍不住笑了，還用手機拍照。
no one but you: No one but you knows the way to the secret beach, so please come with us and show us the path.
只有你知道去那個秘密海灘的路，所以請和我們一起來帶路。
have no choice but to go: The last bus had already left, so we had no choice but to go home on foot in the cold rain.
最後一班公車已經開走了，所以我們別無選擇只能在冷雨中走路回家。
but for your help: But for your help with the science project, I would never have finished it before Monday morning.
要不是你幫忙科學專題，我絕不可能在星期一早上之前完成。
next to the last: Our class room is next to the last on the third floor, but the music room is the very last one.
我們的教室是三樓倒數第二間，但音樂教室是最後一間。
the next but one: My house is the next but one from the corner store, so you will see it right after the blue gate.
我家是從轉角商店數過去隔一間，所以你會在藍色大門之後馬上看到它。
but (除了, 介係詞) vs. but (但是, 連接詞): Everyone but Tom wanted pizza for dinner, but he asked for noodles because he had pizza at lunch.
除了湯姆，大家晚餐都想吃披薩，但是他要吃麵，因為他午餐已經吃過披薩了。
nothing but (只有) vs. anything but (絕不是): The baby drank nothing but milk for six months, and taking care of her was anything but a simple job.
這個嬰兒六個月來只喝牛奶，而照顧她絕非一件簡單的工作。
all but (幾乎) vs. all but one (除一個外): The game was all but over when our team scored twice, and all but one of the fans had already left.
我們隊連得兩分時比賽幾乎結束了，而除了一位以外的球迷都已經離開了。
cannot but + V: When I saw the little boy crying alone in the park, I could not but stop and ask him what was wrong.
當我看到小男孩獨自在公園哭，我不得不停下來問他怎麼了。
cannot help + V-ing: The joke was so funny that even the teacher could not help laughing, but she soon asked us to be quiet.
那個笑話太好笑了，連老師都忍不住笑出來，但她很快就要我們安靜。
but for: But for the kind driver who stopped his truck, the lost puppy would have been hit by a car on the road.
要不是那位好心的司機停下卡車，走失的小狗就會在路上被車撞到。
two plus two: My little brother is only five, but he already knows that two plus two is four and can count to one hundred.
我弟弟才五歲，但他已經知道二加二等於四，還能數到一百。
ten plus: The small boat can carry ten plus people, so our whole class cannot go across the lake at the same time.
這艘小船可以載十人以上，所以我們全班不能同時過湖。
a plus: Being able to speak both English and Japanese is a plus when you look for a job at the airport.
當你在機場找工作時，會說英文和日文兩種語言是一個優點。
on the plus side: We lost the game today, but on the plus side, we learned a lot and nobody on the team got hurt.
我們今天輸了比賽，但好的一面是，我們學到很多，而且隊上沒有人受傷。
plus or minus: The trip will cost about three thousand dollars, plus or minus a few hundred for food and small gifts.
這次旅行大約要花三千元，加減幾百元的食物和小禮物費用。
plus size: This clothes store sells plus size dresses in many colors, so my aunt can always find something nice there.
這家服飾店賣很多顏色的大尺碼洋裝，所以我阿姨總能在那裡找到好看的衣服。
ten minus three: The teacher wrote ten minus three on the board, and the whole class shouted seven at the same time.
老師在黑板上寫了十減三，全班同時喊出七。
minus ten degrees: It was minus ten degrees in Japan last winter, so we wore three coats and still felt very cold.
去年冬天日本是零下十度，所以我們穿了三件外套還是覺得很冷。
a minus: The apartment is close to the school, but the noisy street outside is a minus for people who sleep lightly.
這間公寓離學校很近，但外面吵鬧的街道對睡眠淺的人來說是個缺點。
plus and minus: Before you buy the new phone, write down the plus and minus of it, and then make your choice.
在你買新手機之前，先寫下它的優缺點，然後再做決定。
come back minus one shoe: My little sister came back from the beach minus one shoe, and she could not remember where she lost it.
我妹妹從海灘回來時少了一隻鞋，她不記得在哪裡弄丟的。
minus points: You will get minus points on the test if you forget to write your name at the top of the paper.
如果你忘了在考卷上方寫名字，考試會被扣分。
the minus sign: The minus sign in front of the number means it is less than zero, so the weather was really cold.
數字前面的負號表示它小於零，所以天氣真的很冷。
because of you: I joined the school music club because of you, and now I love playing the guitar with my new friends.
我因為你才加入學校的音樂社，現在我喜歡和新朋友一起彈吉他。
because of the traffic: We missed the first ten minutes of the movie because of the traffic, so we did not understand the story.
因為塞車，我們錯過了電影的前十分鐘，所以我們看不懂故事。
because of his hard work: Jack got the top score in the whole school because of his hard work, and his parents were very proud.
由於他的努力，傑克拿到全校最高分，他的父母非常驕傲。
be late because of the bus: Many students were late because of the bus this morning, so the teacher waited ten minutes before the test.
今天早上很多學生因為公車而遲到，所以老師等了十分鐘才考試。
cancel because of bad weather: The school had to cancel the sports day because of bad weather, and all the students were a little sad.
學校因為天候不佳而不得不取消運動會，所有學生都有點難過。
because of that: My brother broke my favorite cup last week, and because of that, I did not talk to him for two days.
我哥哥上星期打破了我最喜歡的杯子，因為那樣，我兩天沒和他說話。
not because of money: My father chose this job not because of money, but because he loves teaching little children how to read.
我爸爸選擇這份工作不是因為錢，而是因為他喜歡教小孩子閱讀。
because of + 名詞 vs. because + 子句: We stayed home because of the typhoon, and we could not go out because the wind was too strong.
我們因為颱風待在家裡，而且因為風太強所以我們出不了門。
because of the rain vs. because it raine: The game was stopped because of the rain, and because it rained all night, the field was still wet today.
比賽因為雨而中止，而且因為下了整晚的雨，今天場地還是濕的。
because of: Our picnic was put off because of the heavy rain, so we played board games at my house all afternoon instead.
我們的野餐由於大雨而延期，所以我們整個下午改在我家玩桌遊。
thanks to (多正面) vs. because of (中性): Thanks to my teacher, I passed the English test, but my brother failed his because of a bad cold.
多謝我的老師，我通過了英文考試，但我哥哥因為重感冒沒通過他的考試。
as a result of: Many trains were late today as a result of the heavy snow, and some roads were closed because of it too.
由於大雪，今天很多火車誤點，有些道路也因為大雪封閉了。
instead of coffee: At breakfast my mother always drinks hot milk tea instead of coffee, because coffee makes her heart beat fast.
早餐時我媽媽總是喝熱奶茶而不是咖啡，因為咖啡讓她心跳加快。
go instead of me: I have a fever today, so could you please go instead of me to pick up the books at the library?
我今天發燒，所以你可以代替我去圖書館拿書嗎？
walk instead of driving: On sunny days, my parents walk to the market instead of driving, because it is good exercise and saves gas.
天氣好的日子，我爸媽走路去市場而不開車，因為這是好運動又省油。
stay home instead of going out: When it rains hard on the weekend, we usually stay home instead of going out, and we watch old movies together.
週末下大雨時，我們通常待在家而不出門，一起看老電影。
instead of that: Instead of that heavy jacket, you should wear this light sweater, because the weather will be warm this afternoon.
你應該穿這件薄毛衣，而不是那件厚夾克，因為今天下午天氣會很暖。
use honey instead of sugar: My grandmother likes to use honey instead of sugar when she makes tea, because she thinks it is healthier.
我奶奶泡茶時喜歡用蜂蜜代替糖，因為她覺得這樣比較健康。
Instead of crying about the lost game, do something useful like practicing your shots for the next match.
別為輸掉的比賽哭了，做點有用的事，像是為下一場比賽練習投籃。
study instead of playing games: If you study instead of playing games every evening this week, you will surely do well on the big test.
如果這星期每天晚上你讀書而不玩遊戲，你大考一定會考得好。
instead of + N/V-ing (介係詞) vs. instead (: Instead of taking the bus, Tom rode his bike to school, and his sister decided to walk there instead.
湯姆沒搭公車，而是騎腳踏車上學，他姊姊則反而決定走路去。
All my friends went to the mall on Saturday, but I was tired, so I stayed home instead and slept.
我所有的朋友星期六都去了購物中心，但我很累，所以我反而待在家睡覺。
instead of going out: Instead of going out for dinner, we cooked a big pot of soup at home and invited our neighbors over.
我們沒出門吃晚餐，而是在家煮了一大鍋湯，還邀請鄰居過來。
instead of: The teacher used a short video instead of the textbook today, and the whole class understood the lesson much better.
老師今天用一支短片代替課本，全班對這一課理解得好多了。
in one's place: Our math teacher is sick, so instead of her, a young teacher from another school is teaching in her place.
我們的數學老師生病了，所以另一所學校的年輕老師代替她來上課，而不是她本人。
in front of the school: Every morning hundreds of students wait in front of the school gate, and the street gets very busy with cars and scooters.
每天早上好幾百個學生在學校大門前面等待，街上車子和機車變得非常繁忙。
stand in front of the class: Amy was so nervous when she had to stand in front of the class and read her short story aloud.
艾美必須站在全班面前大聲朗讀她的短篇故事時，她非常緊張。
park in front of the house: My father always parks his old blue car in front of the house because our garage is full of boxes.
我爸爸總是把他的藍色舊車停在房子前面，因為我們的車庫堆滿了箱子。
in front of the TV: Grandpa likes to sit in front of the TV after dinner and watch the baseball game with a cup of tea.
爺爺喜歡晚餐後坐在電視機前，一邊喝茶一邊看棒球比賽。
right in front of you: You do not need to look for your glasses anymore because they are right in front of you on the desk.
你不用再找眼鏡了，因為它們就在你眼前的桌子上。
the car in front of us: The car in front of us stopped suddenly, so Dad stopped our car quickly and we all shouted in surprise.
我們前面的車突然停下來，所以爸爸很快把車停住，我們全都驚訝地大叫。
in front of everyone: Jack fell off his bike in front of everyone at school, but he just laughed and got up again.
傑克在學校大家面前從腳踏車上跌下來，但他只是笑一笑又站了起來。
sit in front of the computer: If you sit in front of the computer for too many hours, your eyes will feel tired and dry.
如果你坐在電腦前太多個小時，你的眼睛會覺得疲倦又乾澀。
in front of (外部前方) vs. in the front of (: The dog is sleeping in front of the house, but the cat is hiding in the front of the car.
狗睡在房子前面，但貓卻躲在車子內部的前方。
a tree in front of the house: There is a tall tree in front of the house, and in summer we enjoy sitting under its cool leaves.
屋前有一棵高大的樹，夏天時我們很享受坐在它涼爽的樹葉下。
a seat in the front of the bus: I always choose a seat in the front of the bus because I feel sick when I sit at the back.
我總是選公車前排的座位，因為坐在後面會讓我覺得想吐。
in front of vs. before (時間／抽象): Please wait in front of the library, and remember to finish your homework before you come to meet me.
請在圖書館前面等我，並記得來見我之前先把作業做完。
in front of vs. ahead of (前方更遠／領先): Mary stood in front of the door, but her brother was already far ahead of us on the road.
瑪麗站在門的正前方，而她弟弟已經在路上遠遠領先我們了。
behind (後面) vs. in front of (前面): In this photo, my little sister is standing in front of me, and my tall cousin is behind me.
在這張照片裡，我妹妹站在我前面，而我高高的表哥站在我後面。
at the front of: Mary stood in front of the school gate, and her shy brother sat quietly at the front of the bus.
瑪麗站在校門前面，而她害羞的弟弟安靜地坐在公車前部。
in front vs. in the front: The runner from our class is in front, and his best friend is sitting in the front of the bus.
我們班的跑者跑在前面，而他最好的朋友坐在公車前排。
in the front of the room: The teacher put a big map of Taiwan in the front of the room so every student could see it.
老師把一張很大的臺灣地圖放在教室前部，這樣每個學生都看得見。
sit in the front of the bus: On our school trip, Lisa wanted to sit in the front of the bus and talk to the driver.
校外教學時，麗莎想坐在公車前排，跟司機聊天。
a picture in the front of the book: There is a colorful picture in the front of the book, and it shows the hero and his dog.
書的前面有一張彩色的圖，上面畫著主角和他的狗。
in the front of the line: Peter arrived early, so he was in the front of the line when the shop opened at nine.
彼得早到了，所以商店九點開門時他排在隊伍前面。
the front of the car: The front of the car was broken after the accident, but luckily nobody inside got hurt at all.
車禍後車頭撞壞了，但幸運的是車裡沒有人受傷。
in the back of the room: The tall students sat in the back of the room, and the short ones sat near the teacher.
高的學生坐在教室後方，矮的學生則坐在老師旁邊。
next to the door: Put your wet umbrella next to the door, and then come into the kitchen for some hot soup.
把你濕的雨傘放在門旁邊，然後進廚房喝點熱湯。
sit next to me: Come and sit next to me at lunch, and I will share my mom's delicious fried chicken with you.
午餐時過來坐在我旁邊，我會跟你分享我媽做的美味炸雞。
the house next to ours: The house next to ours is empty now because the old couple moved to Taichung last month.
我們隔壁的房子現在是空的，因為那對老夫婦上個月搬到台中去了。
next to the window: Our table next to the window is perfect because we can watch the rain while we eat dessert.
我們靠窗的桌子很完美，因為我們可以邊吃甜點邊看雨。
the shop next to the bank: The shop next to the bank sells cheap notebooks, so students often go there after school.
銀行隔壁的店賣便宜的筆記本，所以學生放學後常去那裡。
stand next to each other: The two sisters stood next to each other in the photo, and nobody could tell which one was Ann.
兩姊妹在照片裡並排站著，沒有人能分辨哪一個是安。
next to nothing: I know next to nothing about cooking, so I asked my grandmother to teach me this weekend.
我對做菜幾乎一無所知，所以我請奶奶這個週末教我。
next to impossible: It is next to impossible to finish this long report in one night, so let us start right now.
一個晚上要完成這份長報告幾乎不可能，所以我們現在就開始吧。
cost next to nothing: These sweet tomatoes cost next to nothing at the night market, so my mom bought two big bags.
這些甜番茄在夜市幾乎不花錢，所以我媽買了兩大袋。
know next to nothing: Although Tom lived in Japan for a year, he still knows next to nothing about Japanese food.
雖然湯姆在日本住了一年，他對日本食物還是幾乎一無所知。
next to new: My uncle's bike looks next to new because he cleans it carefully every Sunday after breakfast.
我叔叔的腳踏車看起來幾乎全新，因為他每個星期天早餐後都仔細清洗它。
next to (緊鄰) vs. near (附近): The post office is next to our school, but the hospital is only near it, across the park.
郵局緊鄰我們學校，但醫院只是在它附近，隔著公園。
next to (旁邊) vs. next (下一個): The girl sitting next to me is Lily, and the next student to speak will be her brother.
坐在我旁邊的女孩是莉莉，而下一個要發言的學生是她哥哥。
next door to: The family that lives next door to us has three noisy dogs, but they are very friendly animals.
住在我們隔壁的那家人養了三隻很吵的狗，但它們是非常友善的動物。
next to nothing (幾乎沒有) vs. nothing: Kevin ate next to nothing at dinner because he was sad, and his little brother ate nothing at all.
凱文晚餐幾乎什麼都沒吃，因為他很難過，而他弟弟則完全沒吃。
in spite of the rain: In spite of the rain, hundreds of fans stood outside the hall and waited for the singer to arrive.
儘管下雨，數百名粉絲還是站在大廳外等待歌手到來。
in spite of the cold: In spite of the cold, my grandfather swims in the sea every morning before the sun comes up.
儘管寒冷，我爺爺每天早上太陽升起前都會去海裡游泳。
in spite of everything: In spite of everything that happened this year, Judy still smiles and says she is lucky to have friends.
儘管今年發生了這麼多事，茱蒂依然微笑著說有朋友真幸運。
in spite of his age: In spite of his age, Mr. Lin runs five kilometers every day and beats many young people in races.
儘管他年紀大，林先生每天跑五公里，而且在比賽中贏過許多年輕人。
in spite of the pain: In spite of the pain in her leg, the brave girl finished the race and received a big prize.
儘管腿很痛，這個勇敢的女孩還是跑完比賽並得到了大獎。
in spite of what you said: In spite of what you said yesterday, I still believe our team can win the final game on Saturday.
儘管你昨天那樣說，我仍然相信我們的隊伍能贏得星期六的決賽。
in spite of oneself: The movie was so funny that my serious father laughed in spite of himself and dropped his popcorn.
這部電影太好笑了，我嚴肅的爸爸不由自主地笑了出來，還把爆米花掉在地上。
in spite of the price: In spite of the price, Helen bought the beautiful red dress because she wanted to wear it to the party.
儘管價格高，海倫還是買了那件漂亮的紅洋裝，因為她想穿去參加派對。
in spite of + 名詞 vs. although + 子句: In spite of the heavy snow, the school stayed open, although many students arrived late and cold.
儘管下大雪，學校仍然開放，雖然很多學生到校時又遲又冷。
in spite of the rain vs. although it rai: We played soccer in spite of the rain, and although it rained all afternoon, nobody wanted to stop.
儘管下雨我們還是踢足球，雖然整個下午都在下雨，卻沒有人想停下來。
in spite of the fact that: In spite of the fact that he was tired, Dad drove three hours to take us to the beach.
儘管事實是他很累，爸爸還是開了三小時的車帶我們去海邊。
thanks to you: Thanks to you, I passed the math test today, so let me buy you a cup of milk tea after school.
多虧了你，我今天通過了數學考試，所以放學後讓我請你喝一杯奶茶。
thanks to his help: Thanks to his help, we finished all the work in the whole room before the bell rang at four o'clock.
多虧他的幫忙，我們在四點鐘鐘聲響起前就把整間教室的工作全做完了。
thanks to the good weather: Thanks to the good weather, our picnic by the river was wonderful and everyone took lots of photos.
多虧天氣好，我們在河邊的野餐很棒，大家都拍了很多照片。
thanks to the Internet: Thanks to the Internet, my cousin in Canada can talk to our grandmother every night and see her face.
多虧有網路，我在加拿大的表哥每天晚上都能跟奶奶聊天並看到她的臉。
thanks to hard work: Thanks to hard work, Jenny went from the worst student in English class to the best one this year.
多虧努力，珍妮今年從英文課最差的學生變成了最好的學生。
Thanks to the heavy rain, the baseball game was off, and we had to stay home and do our homework.
因為下大雨，棒球比賽取消了，我們只好待在家裡寫作業。
thanks to modern science: Thanks to modern science, doctors today can help many sick children who could not get better in the past.
多虧現代科學，今天的醫生能幫助許多過去無法康復的生病兒童。
thanks to my teacher: Thanks to my teacher, I am not afraid of speaking English anymore, and I even gave a speech at school.
多虧我的老師，我不再害怕說英文，甚至還在學校發表了一場演講。
according to the news: According to the news, a strong typhoon will hit Taiwan this weekend, so we should buy some food today.
根據新聞，一個強烈颱風這個週末會侵襲臺灣，所以我們今天應該買一些食物。
according to the teacher: According to the teacher, the test next week will cover only the first three lessons of the book.
根據老師所說，下週的考試只會考課本的前三課。
according to the plan: According to the plan, we will visit the museum in the morning and go shopping in the afternoon.
按照計畫，我們早上會參觀博物館，下午去逛街。
according to the map: According to the map, the train station is only ten minutes away from the night market on foot.
根據地圖，火車站走路到夜市只要十分鐘。
according to the rules: According to the rules, students cannot use their phones in class unless the teacher says it is all right.
依規定，除非老師說可以，學生不能在課堂上使用手機。
according to the weather report: According to the weather report, it will be sunny and hot tomorrow, so bring a hat to the beach.
根據氣象報告，明天會是晴朗炎熱的天氣，所以去海邊要帶帽子。
according to him: According to him, the new restaurant near the park is cheap and delicious, so let us try it tonight.
據他說，公園附近那家新餐廳便宜又好吃，所以我們今晚去試試吧。
according to size: Mom put the shirts in the closet according to size, with the small ones on the left side.
媽媽按尺寸把襯衫放進衣櫃，小的放在左邊。
according to the law: According to the law, children under twelve must sit in the back seat when they ride in a car.
依法，十二歲以下的兒童坐車時必須坐在後座。
according to my watch: According to my watch, the movie started five minutes ago, so we need to run to the theater now.
照我的手錶，電影五分鐘前就開始了，所以我們現在得跑去電影院。
according to sb. (非 according to me): According to Lisa, the final exam was very easy, but the other students said it was hard for them.
據麗莎說，期末考很簡單，但其他學生說對他們來說很難。
in my opinion (非 according to me): Do not say according to me when you share your idea; say in my opinion, the movie is boring.
分享想法時不要說 according to me，要說「依我看，這部電影很無聊」。
according to vs. based on: According to the book, this story is based on the real life of a brave young girl in Tainan.
根據這本書，這個故事是基於台南一位勇敢少女的真實生活。
according to the plan vs. as planned: According to the plan, the bus left at eight, and everything went just as planned during the trip.
按照計畫，公車八點出發，而旅途中一切都如計畫般順利進行。
according to vs. depending on: According to the teacher, the picnic will be on Friday, but the place depends on the weather.
根據老師所說，野餐將在星期五舉行，但地點取決於天氣。
along with his friends: Jason went to the night market along with his friends, and they ate fried chicken and played games.
傑森和他的朋友一起去夜市，他們吃了炸雞也玩了遊戲。
along with the letter: Grandma sent a box of her own cookies along with the letter, and we finished them in one day.
奶奶連同這封信寄來一盒她親手做的餅乾，我們一天就把餅乾吃完了。
along with everything else: When we moved to the new house, we lost my favorite toy along with everything else in that old box.
我們搬到新家時，我最喜歡的玩具連同那個舊箱子裡的其他一切都不見了。
go along with the idea: At first Dad did not like our plan, but he finally went along with the idea of a trip to Japan.
起初爸爸不喜歡我們的計畫，但他最後贊同了去日本旅行的想法。
along with that: Mike got a new job in Taipei, and along with that came a busy life and a very small apartment.
麥克在台北找到新工作，隨之而來的是忙碌的生活和一間很小的公寓。
send it along with the gift: Please write a short card for Grandpa, and I will send it along with the gift before his birthday.
請幫爺爺寫一張短卡片，我會在他生日前連同禮物一起寄出。
ahead of time: The students arrived ahead of time, so they had a few minutes to review their notes before the test.
學生們提前到達，所以考試前有幾分鐘可以複習筆記。
ahead of the others: Nancy finished the puzzle ahead of the others because she had practiced with her dad every night this week.
南西比其他人先完成拼圖，因為這週她每晚都和爸爸練習。
walk ahead of me: Please do not walk ahead of me in the dark forest because I am afraid of getting lost.
請不要在黑暗的森林裡走在我前面，因為我怕迷路。
be ahead of the times: My grandfather bought a computer in 1985, so his friends said he was always ahead of the times.
我爺爺在一九八五年就買了電腦，所以他的朋友說他總是走在時代前面。
go ahead of the group: The guide told us not to go ahead of the group because the mountain path was dangerous and wet.
導遊告訴我們不要走在隊伍前面，因為山路又危險又濕滑。
two points ahead of: Our basketball team was two points ahead of the other school when the last minute of the game began.
比賽最後一分鐘開始時，我們的籃球隊領先另一所學校兩分。
ahead of the game: Sandy always reads the next lesson before class, so she stays ahead of the game in every subject.
珊蒂總是在上課前先讀下一課，所以她在每一科都占上風。
ahead of (領先／前方) vs. in front of (正前方): Tom is standing in front of the gate, but Mary is already far ahead of him on the road.
湯姆站在大門正前方，但瑪麗已經在路上遠遠領先他了。
Rita arrived at the station ahead of time, Ken got there on time, and I came just in time.
麗塔提前到車站，肯準時到，而我則及時趕到。
ahead of vs. before (時間): Please hand in your report ahead of Friday, and remember to check your spelling before you print it out.
請在星期五之前提早交報告，並記得列印前檢查拼字。
behind (落後) vs. ahead of (領先): Our team was behind at first, but after the third goal we were far ahead of the other players.
我們的隊伍起初落後，但第三球之後我們就遠遠領先其他球員了。
go ahead (請便) vs. go ahead of (走在…前面): Go ahead and start eating, but do not go ahead of Grandma when we walk to the temple later.
請便，先開始吃吧，但等一下走去廟裡時不要走在奶奶前面。
far from home: When Sam studied in a city far from home, he called his mother every night because he missed her.
山姆在離家很遠的城市念書時，每天晚上都打電話給媽媽，因為他很想她。
far from perfect: My English is far from perfect, but I still try to talk to foreign visitors in the night market.
我的英文離完美還很遠，但我仍然試著在夜市跟外國遊客交談。
far from happy: Linda was far from happy when she saw the low score on her science test this morning.
琳達今天早上看到自然考試的低分時，一點也不開心。
far from it: Do you think I am angry with you? Far from it, I am just too tired to talk tonight.
你以為我在生你的氣嗎？完全不是，我只是今晚太累不想說話。
far from easy: Learning to ride a bike was far from easy for me, and I fell down more than ten times.
學騎腳踏車對我來說一點也不容易，我跌倒了超過十次。
be far from the truth: The story in that newspaper is far from the truth, so do not believe everything you read in the news.
那份報紙上的報導與事實相去甚遠，所以不要相信你在新聞裡讀到的一切。
not far from the station: Our new apartment is not far from the station, so my father can walk to work in five minutes.
我們的新公寓離車站不遠，所以爸爸可以走五分鐘去上班。
I started my new job last week, and when my mom asked about it, I said, So far, so good.
我上週開始新工作，當媽媽問起時，我說：到目前為止都好。
as far as the eye can see: From the top of the mountain, there were green tea fields as far as the eye could see.
從山頂往下看，目力所及之處都是綠色的茶園。
as far as the park: Every morning my grandmother walks as far as the park, and then she rests on a bench and feeds the birds.
每天早上我奶奶都走到公園那麼遠，然後坐在長椅上休息餵鳥。
far from being over: The rain stopped for a while, but the typhoon is far from being over, so stay inside tonight.
雨暫時停了，但颱風遠未結束，所以今晚待在室內。
far from (距離) vs. far from (絕非): The school is far from my house, and the long walk there is far from fun on a rainy day.
學校離我家很遠，而在雨天走這麼遠的路一點也不有趣。
far from here (距離): The zoo is far from here, so we should take the MRT first and then change to a bus.
動物園離這裡很遠，所以我們應該先搭捷運，然後再換公車。
far from easy (絕非): Making a cake without any help is far from easy, and my first one looked like a big brown rock.
沒有任何幫助做蛋糕絕非容易，我做的第一個看起來像一塊大大的棕色石頭。
far from vs. far away from: My school is far from the beach, and the beach is also far away from the nearest bus stop.
我的學校離海邊很遠，而海邊離最近的公車站也很遠。
far from vs. near: The library is near my house, but the swimming pool is far from it, so I ride my bike there.
圖書館離我家很近，但游泳池離家很遠，所以我騎腳踏車去。
as far as (遠到／就…而言) vs. as long as (只要): We walked as far as the bridge, and Dad said we could keep going as long as it did not rain.
我們走到橋那麼遠，爸爸說只要不下雨我們就可以繼續走。
so far (到目前為止) vs. by far (遠遠地): So far I have read three books this month, and the last one is by far the most exciting.
到目前為止我這個月讀了三本書，而最後一本是遠遠最刺激的一本。
stay away from the fire: Stay away from the fire when you cook outside, because the strong wind can blow the hot smoke into your face.
在戶外煮東西時要遠離火，因為強風會把熱煙吹到你臉上。
keep away from the dog: Keep away from the big dog by the gate because it barks at strangers and might bite you.
離大門旁那隻大狗遠一點，因為它會對陌生人吠叫，可能會咬你。
run away from home: After a big fight with his parents, the boy wanted to run away from home, but his sister stopped him.
跟父母大吵一架後，男孩想逃家，但他姊姊阻止了他。
walk away from the problem: You cannot walk away from the problem all the time, so talk to your teacher about the missing homework today.
你不能一直逃避問題，所以今天就跟老師談談沒交的作業吧。
be away from school: Jenny will be away from school for a week because she is going to visit her grandmother in Japan.
珍妮會有一週不在學校，因為她要去日本看她的奶奶。
get away from it all: After a busy year, my parents went to a quiet mountain village to get away from it all for a weekend.
忙碌了一年之後，我爸媽去一個安靜的山村，度過一個遠離一切的週末。
turn away from: The sad movie made Lucy turn away from the screen, and she cried quietly into her brother's shoulder.
這部悲傷的電影讓露西轉身不看螢幕，她安靜地靠在哥哥肩上哭了。
look away from the screen: The doctor told me to look away from the screen every twenty minutes and rest my eyes for a while.
醫生告訴我每二十分鐘要把視線移開螢幕，讓眼睛休息一下。
a mile away from here: The nearest supermarket is about a mile away from here, so let us drive there instead of walking.
最近的超市離這裡大約一英里，所以我們開車去，不要走路。
far away from the city: My grandfather lives on a farm far away from the city, where the air is clean and the nights are quiet.
我爺爺住在離城市很遠的農場，那裡空氣乾淨、夜晚寧靜。
back away from: When the little girl saw the snake on the path, she started to back away from it slowly and quietly.
小女孩看到小路上的蛇時，開始慢慢地、安靜地後退遠離它。
shy away from: Peter is a quiet boy who likes to shy away from big parties, but he loves small dinners with friends.
彼得是個安靜的男孩，喜歡迴避大型派對，但他喜愛和朋友的小型晚餐聚會。
take away from: The rain did not take away from the fun of our trip, and we still laughed all the way home.
下雨並沒有減損我們旅行的樂趣，我們回家的路上還是一路笑著。
stay away from trouble: Mom always tells my brother to stay away from trouble at school and to choose his friends carefully.
媽媽總是叫我弟弟在學校別惹麻煩，並且要小心選擇朋友。
be miles away: The teacher asked Ben a question twice, but he was miles away, thinking about his basketball game.
老師問了班兩次問題，但他心不在焉，正想著他的籃球比賽。
right away: Mom said the soup was burning, so I turned off the stove right away and opened the window.
媽媽說湯燒焦了，所以我立刻關掉爐子並打開窗戶。
away from home: My aunt works away from home most of the year, so she only sees her children on holidays.
我阿姨一年大部分時間都離家在外工作，所以她只有在假日才見得到孩子。
fruits such as apples and bananas: Fruits such as apples and bananas are good for your health, so eat some every day after lunch.
像蘋果、香蕉等水果對健康有益，所以每天午餐後要吃一些。
sports such as baseball: My brother loves sports such as baseball and basketball, and he plays with his friends every weekend.
我弟弟喜歡像棒球、籃球這類運動，他每個週末都和朋友一起玩。
animals such as cats and dogs: Animals such as cats and dogs make great pets because they are friendly and love being with people.
貓狗之類的動物是很棒的寵物，因為它們友善又喜歡跟人在一起。
countries such as Japan: Many students want to visit countries such as Japan and Korea because they love the food and the music.
許多學生想去像日本、韓國等國家，因為他們喜愛那裡的食物和音樂。
hobbies such as reading: Quiet hobbies such as reading and drawing help me rest after a long and busy day at school.
像閱讀、畫畫這類安靜的嗜好幫助我在學校漫長忙碌的一天後好好休息。
subjects such as math: Subjects such as math and science are hard for me, but I enjoy history and English very much.
像數學、自然這類科目對我來說很難，但我很喜歡歷史和英文。
such as (列舉) vs. for example (舉例, 可獨立): I like sweet food such as cake and ice cream; for example, I ate three pieces of cake yesterday.
我喜歡像蛋糕、冰淇淋這類甜食；舉例來說，我昨天吃了三塊蛋糕。
such as (例如) vs. such…as (像…那樣的): I enjoy drinks such as milk tea, but I have never had such a sweet drink as this one.
我喜歡像奶茶這類飲料，但我從沒喝過像這杯那樣甜的飲料。
such a good boy: Mark helped the old woman carry her bags, and she said he was such a good boy with a big smile.
馬克幫老太太提袋子，她笑著說他真是這麼好的男孩。
such as it is: My cooking, such as it is, is ready, so please sit down and try the soup before it gets cold.
我的料理，雖然不怎麼樣，已經準備好了，所以請坐下來趁熱喝湯。
such…that (如此…以致): The weather was such a hot day that we stayed in the pool for three hours and forgot about lunch.
那天天氣如此炎熱，以致我們在游泳池待了三個小時，連午餐都忘了。
and so on: At the night market you can buy snacks such as fried chicken, sweet potatoes, fish balls and so on.
在夜市你可以買到像炸雞、地瓜、魚丸等等的小吃。
as for the price: The new phone looks great and takes clear pictures, but as for the price, it is too high for me.
這支新手機看起來很棒，照片也很清楚，但至於價格，對我來說太高了。
as for the rest: We finished half of the homework at school, and as for the rest, we can do it together tonight.
我們在學校做完一半作業，至於其餘的，我們今晚可以一起做。
as for the weather: The hotel was clean and the food was great, but as for the weather, it rained every single day.
飯店很乾淨，食物也很棒，但至於天氣，每一天都在下雨。
as for your question: As for your question about the school trip, the teacher will give us the answer tomorrow morning.
至於你關於校外教學的問題，老師明天早上會給我們答案。
as for that: I have already chosen my new school bag, and as for that red one, you can have it if you like.
我已經選好新書包了，至於那個紅色的，如果你喜歡可以拿去。
as for (至於) vs. as to (關於): As for the movie, I liked it a lot, but as to the ending, I think it was a little strange.
至於這部電影，我很喜歡，但關於結局，我覺得有點奇怪。
as for (換話題) vs. for (為了): I bought this cake for Mom, and as for Dad, I will cook his favorite noodles for his birthday.
我買這個蛋糕是為了媽媽，至於爸爸，我會為他生日煮他最愛的麵。
as to whether: As to whether we will have class on Friday, the teacher said she would tell us after the typhoon passes.
關於星期五是否要上課，老師說颱風過後再告訴我們。
apart from that: The new apartment is small, but apart from that, it is perfect for our family and close to the MRT station.
新公寓很小，但除此之外，對我們家來說很完美，而且離捷運站很近。
apart from the price: Apart from the price, there is nothing wrong with this bike, so I think I will buy it on Saturday.
除了價格以外，這台腳踏車沒有任何問題，所以我想星期六買下它。
apart from Tom, everyone came: Apart from Tom, everyone came to the party, and we all asked why our best friend did not show up.
除了湯姆，大家都來參加派對了，我們都在問為什麼我們最好的朋友沒出現。
apart from English, she speaks French: Apart from English, she speaks French, so she can help the visitors from Paris find their hotel.
除了英文她還會法文，所以她可以幫忙來自巴黎的遊客找到飯店。
live apart from one's family: My uncle has lived apart from his family for two years because he works on a ship in another country.
我叔叔已經與家人分開住兩年了，因為他在另一個國家的船上工作。
stand apart from the others: Her bright pictures stand apart from the others in the art room, so visitors always notice them first.
她色彩鮮明的畫在美術教室裡與眾不同，所以參觀者總是先注意到它們。
tell A apart from B: The two brothers look so alike that even their teacher cannot tell Jim apart from Jack on some days.
這兩兄弟長得太像了，連他們的老師有時候也分辨不出吉姆和傑克。
far apart from each other: My two best friends now live far apart from each other, one in Taipei and the other in Kaohsiung.
我兩個最好的朋友現在彼此相距很遠，一個在台北，另一個在高雄。
set apart from: Her kind heart and warm smile set her apart from the other students, so everyone wants to be her friend.
她善良的心和溫暖的笑容使她與眾不同，所以每個人都想當她的朋友。
fall apart: The old paper box fell apart in the rain, and all my comic books got wet on the way home.
舊紙箱在雨中散掉了，我所有的漫畫書在回家路上都淋濕了。
take apart: My little brother likes to take apart old radios to see how they work, but he never puts them back.
我弟弟喜歡拆開舊收音機看它們怎麼運作，但他從來不會把它們裝回去。
tell them apart: The two puppies look just the same, so we put a red hat on one of them to tell them apart.
這兩隻小狗看起來一模一樣，所以我們幫其中一隻戴上紅帽子來分辨它們。
be worlds apart: My sister and I are worlds apart when it comes to music; she loves rock, and I enjoy quiet piano songs.
說到音樂，我和姊姊天差地遠；她愛搖滾，而我喜歡安靜的鋼琴曲。
grow apart: We were close friends in high school, but we grew apart after she moved to another city.
我們在中學是好朋友，但她搬到另一個城市後，我們就漸漸疏遠了。
apart from work: Apart from work, my father spends most of his time in the garden, growing tomatoes and sweet peppers.
工作之外，我爸爸大部分時間都待在花園裡種番茄和甜椒。
apart from (除了, 可含可不含) vs. except (不含) v: Apart from Lily, five students passed the test; except Lily, nobody failed; besides Lily, Tom also got full marks.
除了莉莉，有五個學生通過考試；除了莉莉以外沒人不及格；除了莉莉，湯姆也拿了滿分。
apart from: Apart from the long bus ride, the trip was perfect, and aside from that, we had no problems at all.
除了漫長的公車車程，這次旅行很完美，除此之外，我們完全沒有任何問題。
apart (分開, 副詞) vs. apart from (介係詞): The two friends sat apart during the test, but apart from that short hour, they were always together.
考試時這兩個朋友分開坐，但除了那短短一小時以外，他們總是在一起。
a part (一部分) vs. apart (分開): A part of the cake is missing because my brother cut it apart from the rest and ate it secretly.
蛋糕少了一部分，因為我弟弟把它從其餘部分切開，偷偷吃掉了。
aside from that: The hotel room was a little small, but aside from that, our trip to Japan was wonderful and fun.
飯店房間有點小，但除此之外，我們的日本之旅很棒也很好玩。
aside from the cost: Aside from the cost, the summer camp sounds great, so I will ask my parents about it tonight.
除了費用之外，夏令營聽起來很棒，所以我今晚會問問爸媽。
aside from a few mistakes: Aside from a few mistakes in spelling, your English letter is very good, and your teacher will be proud.
除了幾個拼字錯誤，你的英文信寫得很好，你的老師會很驕傲。
aside from being late: Aside from being late on the first day, Kevin has done a great job at his new part-time job.
除了第一天遲到以外，凱文在新的打工工作上表現得很好。
put aside: My mother puts aside a little money every month, so we can take a family trip to Japan next year.
我媽媽每個月都存一點錢，這樣我們明年就能全家去日本旅行。
set aside time: If you set aside time for exercise every day, you will feel stronger and sleep much better at night.
如果你每天留出時間運動，你會覺得更強壯，晚上也睡得更好。
step aside: The guard asked the people to step aside so the doctor could get to the sick man quickly.
警衛請人們讓到一邊，好讓醫生能快點到那位生病的男人身邊。
stand aside: Please stand aside and let the old lady with the heavy bags get on the bus before you.
請站開，讓那位提著重袋子的老太太先上公車。
joking aside: Joking aside, you really need to study harder this month if you want to pass the big exam.
說正經的，如果你想通過這次大考，這個月真的需要更努力讀書。
leave it aside: Let us leave it aside for now and talk about the math problem again after dinner when we are not tired.
我們先把它放著，晚餐後等我們不累時再來討論這道數學題。
take sb. aside: The coach took Tom aside after the game and told him quietly that he needed to practice more.
比賽結束後教練把湯姆拉到一旁，悄悄告訴他需要多練習。
brush aside: My sister often brushes aside my advice, but this time she listened and brought an umbrella to school.
我姊姊常常不理會我的建議，但這次她聽了，帶了雨傘去學校。
lay aside: Dad decided to lay aside the plan for a new car because we need the money for my brother's school.
爸爸決定擱置買新車的計畫，因為我們需要那筆錢付弟弟的學費。
move aside: Could you move aside a little, please? I cannot see the board from my seat at the back.
可以請你移開一點嗎？我從後面的座位看不到黑板。
turn aside: When the smoke from the barbecue blew toward her, Amy turned aside and covered her nose with her hand.
烤肉的煙吹向她時，艾美轉開身，用手遮住鼻子。
aside from work: Aside from work, my mother loves to cook, and her chicken soup is the best thing in our house.
工作之外，我媽媽熱愛做菜，她的雞湯是我們家最棒的東西。
aside from the weather: Aside from the weather, everything about our beach trip was perfect, and we want to go back next summer.
除了天氣，我們海邊之旅的一切都很完美，我們明年夏天還想再去。
all joking aside: All joking aside, we have only two weeks to prepare for the show, so let us start practicing today.
言歸正傳，我們只剩兩個星期準備表演，所以今天就開始練習吧。
together with my friends: I went to the movies together with my friends on Sunday, and we shared a very big bag of popcorn.
星期天我和我朋友一起去看電影，我們分享了一大袋爆米花。
together with the letter: Lisa sent some photos of her new school together with the letter so her grandmother could see her new friends.
麗莎連同這封信寄了幾張新學校的照片，好讓奶奶能看到她的新朋友。
send it together with the bill: The shop will send the new TV together with the bill, so please check both of them when they arrive.
這家店會把新電視連同帳單一起寄來，所以送到時請兩樣都檢查。
together with his family: Every Chinese New Year, my uncle travels back to Tainan together with his family to visit our grandmother.
每年農曆新年，我叔叔都會和家人一起回台南探望我們的奶奶。
together with the price: The clerk wrote down the name of each dish together with the price, so we could check our order.
店員把每道菜的名稱連同價格一起寫下來，讓我們可以核對訂單。
get together with: On weekends I like to get together with my old friends from high school and play basketball.
週末時我喜歡和中學的老朋友聚會，一起打籃球。
work together with: Our class will work together with the students from another school to clean the beach this Saturday.
我們班這個星期六會和另一所學校的學生合作清理海灘。
live together with: Mike lives together with his grandmother in a small house near the river, and he helps her every day.
麥克和奶奶同住在河邊的一間小房子裡，每天都幫她做事。
in the middle of the room: The teacher put a round table in the middle of the room, and the students sat around it to talk.
老師在房間中央放了一張圓桌，學生們圍著它坐下來討論。
in the middle of the class: A bird flew into our room in the middle of the class, and everyone stopped listening to the teacher.
上課上到一半時，一隻鳥飛進我們教室，大家都不再聽老師講課。
in the middle of dinner: The phone rang in the middle of dinner, so Dad had to leave the table and answer it in the kitchen.
晚餐吃到一半時電話響了，所以爸爸只好離開餐桌到廚房去接電話。
in the middle of doing homework: I was in the middle of doing homework when the lights went out, so I finished it with a candle.
我正在做作業時燈熄了，所以我靠一根蠟燭把作業做完。
in the middle of nowhere: Our car broke down in the middle of nowhere, and we waited two hours before another car passed by.
我們的車在荒郊野外壞掉了，我們等了兩小時才有另一輛車經過。
in the middle of the week: Wednesday is in the middle of the week, so my mom always cooks something special to cheer us up.
星期三是週中，所以媽媽總是煮些特別的東西讓我們開心。
in the middle of a meeting: My father was in the middle of a meeting when I called, so he sent me a short message instead.
我打電話時爸爸正在開會，所以他改傳了一則簡短訊息給我。
be caught in the middle: When my two best friends had a big fight, I was caught in the middle and did not know who to help.
我兩個最好的朋友大吵一架時，我夾在中間，不知道該幫誰。
in the middle of winter: In the middle of winter, the top of the mountain is covered with snow, and the lake becomes ice.
隆冬時山頂覆蓋著白雪，湖水也結成了冰。
in the middle of the day: In the middle of the day, the sun is too strong, so farmers usually rest and eat lunch under the trees.
中午時分太陽太強烈，所以農夫通常在樹下休息吃午餐。
on top of the hill: We climbed for two hours, and from the small house on top of the hill we could see the whole city.
我們爬了兩個小時，從山頂上的小屋可以看到整座城市。
on top of the box: The cat likes to sleep on top of the box by the window because the afternoon sun keeps it warm.
那隻貓喜歡睡在窗邊的盒子上面，因為下午的陽光讓它暖呼呼的。
on top of the world: Amy felt on top of the world when she heard that she had won first prize for her English speech.
艾咪聽到自己的英文演講得到第一名時，覺得非常開心。
on top of that: It rained all day during our trip, and on top of that, I lost my wallet somewhere on the bus.
旅行時下了一整天的雨，除此之外，我還把皮夾掉在公車上的某個地方。
on top of everything else: I have a math test tomorrow and piano practice tonight, and on top of everything else, my computer stopped working.
我明天有數學考試，今晚要練鋼琴，而在其他一切之外，我的電腦還壞了。
be on top of things: Our class leader is always on top of things, so she never forgets to hand in the homework list on time.
我們的班長總是掌控一切，所以她從不忘記準時交作業名單。
stay on top of the news: My grandfather reads two newspapers every morning because he likes to stay on top of the news in Taiwan.
我爺爺每天早上看兩份報紙，因為他喜歡隨時掌握臺灣的新聞。
on top of each other: The books were piled on top of each other on the floor, so I could not find my English textbook.
書本疊在一起堆在地板上，所以我找不到我的英文課本。
put it on top of the shelf: Mom asked me to put the cookie box on top of the shelf so that my little brother could not reach it.
媽媽要我把餅乾盒放在架子頂上，這樣我的小弟弟就拿不到。
come out on top: Our basketball team came out on top after a hard game, and the whole school cheered for the players.
我們的籃球隊在一場苦戰之後勝出，全校都為球員們歡呼。
on top: Put the cheese on top, and then bake the pizza in the oven for about fifteen minutes until it turns golden.
把起司放在上面，然後把披薩放進烤箱烤大約十五分鐘，直到變成金黃色。
at the top of: The words at the top of the page tell you the name of the lesson, so read them before you start.
頁面頂端的文字告訉你這一課的名稱，所以開始之前先讀一讀。
at the top of one's voice: The fans sang along at the top of their voices when the singer walked out on the stage on Saturday night.
星期六晚上歌手走上舞臺時，粉絲們大聲地跟著唱。
on top of one's game: Jenny was on top of her game in the final, and she hit every ball back over the net with ease.
珍妮在決賽中狀態絕佳，她輕鬆地把每一球都打回網子另一邊。
The cat is sleeping on top of the warm TV box, a lamp hangs above the desk, and a blanket lies over the sofa.
貓睡在溫暖的電視機頂上，一盞燈掛在書桌上方，一條毯子覆蓋在沙發上。
on top of the hill vs. at the top of the: There is a small temple on top of the hill, and from the top of the hill we can see the whole town.
山頂上有一座小廟，從山頂上我們可以看到整個城鎮。
on top of (除此之外) vs. besides: Besides being small, the hotel room was noisy, and on top of that, the price was very high.
除了房間小之外，飯店房間還很吵，而且除此之外，價格也非常高。
at the top of the page (頂端) vs. on the t: Write your name at the top of the page, and do not put your cup on the top of the printer.
把你的名字寫在頁首，而且不要把杯子放在印表機的頂面上。
top (頂) vs. bottom (底): Write the date on the top of the paper and your name at the bottom, then hand it to the teacher.
把日期寫在紙的頂端，名字寫在底部，然後交給老師。
at the end of the day: At the end of the day, what matters most is that we tried our best and had fun together.
到頭來，最重要的是我們盡了全力，而且一起玩得很開心。
at the end of the year: My family always cleans the whole house at the end of the year to get ready for Chinese New Year.
我家每年年底都會打掃整個房子，為農曆新年做準備。
at the end of the class: The teacher gave us a short quiz at the end of the class to see how much we remembered.
課堂結束時，老師給我們一個小考，看看我們記得多少。
at the end of the week: Jason is going camping with his cousins at the end of the week, so he is busy packing his things now.
傑森週末要和表兄弟們去露營，所以他現在正忙著收拾東西。
at the end of the movie: Everyone in the theater cried at the end of the movie because the old dog finally found its way home.
電影結尾時戲院裡的每個人都哭了，因為那隻老狗終於找到回家的路。
at the end of the term: We will have a big test at the end of the term, so I plan to review one lesson every night.
學期末我們會有一次大考，所以我打算每晚複習一課。
at the end of May: The weather in Taiwan gets really hot at the end of May, and many students start to use fans in class.
臺灣的天氣在五月底變得很熱，許多學生開始在課堂上用電風扇。
at the end of the road: There is a small store at the end of the road, and we often buy ice cream there after school.
路的盡頭有一家小店，我們放學後常去那裡買冰淇淋。
at the end of the hall: The music room is at the end of the hall, so just walk straight and you will hear the piano.
音樂教室在走廊盡頭，所以只要直走，你就會聽到鋼琴聲。
at the end of the line: I stood at the end of the line for almost an hour before I finally got a ticket for the show.
我在隊伍末端站了快一個小時，才終於買到表演的票。
at the end of the street: My best friend lives in the white house at the end of the street, so we walk to school together every day.
我最好的朋友住在街尾那棟白色房子裡，所以我們每天一起走路上學。
at the end of the book: You can find the answers to all the questions at the end of the book, but try them yourself first.
你可以在書末找到所有問題的答案，但先自己試試看。
at the end of the table: My grandfather always sits at the end of the table during dinner, and he tells us stories about his childhood.
吃晚餐時爺爺總是坐在桌子末端，跟我們講他童年的故事。
at the end of (在…結尾) vs. in the end (最後,: At the end of the race, Tom was very tired, but in the end he still won first place for our class.
在比賽的末端，湯姆非常累，但最後他仍然為我們班贏得第一名。
at the end of the day (一天結束) vs. in the: At the end of the day, we were all tired from the trip, but in the end everyone agreed it was worth it.
一天結束時，我們都因為旅行而很累，但最終每個人都同意這很值得。
by the end of (在…結束前) vs. at the end of: Please return the book by the end of the month, and we will talk about it at the end of the last class.
請在月底結束前把書還回來，我們會在最後一堂課結束時討論它。
at the beginning of vs. at the end of: At the beginning of the school year I was shy, but at the end of the year I had many friends.
在學年開頭我很害羞，但在這一年的結尾我有了很多朋友。
to the end (到最後) vs. at the end (在結尾): Amy fought to the end in the tennis match, and at the end of the game everyone stood up and cheered.
艾咪在網球比賽中奮戰直到最後，而在比賽結尾時每個人都站起來歡呼。
end up (最後成為): At the end of the long trip, we ended up sleeping in the car because every hotel in town was full.
在漫長旅程的結尾，我們最後落得在車上睡覺，因為鎮上每家飯店都滿了。
in addition to English: In addition to English, Linda is learning Japanese at a night school, so she can talk with her friend from Japan.
除了英文之外，琳達還在夜校學日文，這樣她就能和她來自日本的朋友聊天。
in addition to that: The hotel has a big swimming pool, and in addition to that, guests can use the bikes for free.
這家飯店有一個大游泳池，除此之外，客人還可以免費使用腳踏車。
in addition to his job: In addition to his job at the bank, my uncle teaches guitar to children on Saturday mornings for fun.
除了銀行的工作以外，我叔叔星期六早上還教小孩彈吉他當作興趣。
in addition to the price: You need to pay for food and drinks on the train in addition to the price of the ticket, so bring enough cash.
除了車票的價格之外，你還需要付火車上的食物和飲料錢，所以要帶夠現金。
in addition to being late: In addition to being late for class, Peter forgot his homework, so the teacher was not happy with him at all.
除了上課遲到以外，彼得還忘了帶作業，所以老師對他一點也不滿意。
in addition (單用, 副詞): The new library is close to our school, and in addition, it stays open until nine every night, so we study there.
新圖書館離我們學校很近，此外，它每晚開到九點，所以我們在那裡讀書。
in addition to + N (包含) vs. except (不含): In addition to rice, we ate fish and soup at dinner, but my little sister ate everything except the fish.
晚餐時除了米飯之外我們還吃了魚和湯，但我的小妹妹除了魚以外什麼都吃了。
in addition to: In addition to math, Kevin likes science as well as music, so besides studying, he is in the school band.
除了數學之外，凱文還喜歡自然科學以及音樂，所以除了讀書之外，他還參加學校樂隊。
in addition (句首, 副詞) vs. in addition to: In addition to being a good cook, my aunt sings well, and in addition, she paints beautiful pictures of the sea on weekends.
除了是個好廚師之外，我阿姨歌也唱得好，此外，她週末還會畫美麗的海景畫。
add to (增加) vs. in addition to: In addition to the two new students, a teacher from Japan joined our class, which added to the fun of the trip.
除了兩位新同學之外，還有一位來自日本的老師加入我們班，這為旅行增添了樂趣。
as well as (以及) 連接兩名詞: In addition to drawing, Tina enjoys dancing as well as singing, so she joins a different club each term.
除了畫畫之外，蒂娜還喜歡跳舞以及唱歌，所以她每學期都參加不同的社團。
in case of rain: In case of rain, the sports day will be moved to the gym, so please listen for the news on Friday morning.
如果下雨，運動會將改到體育館舉行，所以請在星期五早上注意聽消息。
in case of an accident: In case of an accident on the highway, you should call the police and stay inside your car until help comes.
如果在高速公路上發生意外，你應該打電話給警察，並待在車裡直到救援到來。
in case of trouble: In case of trouble during the trip, students should find a teacher at once and never try to deal with it alone.
旅行途中如有麻煩，學生應該立刻找老師，絕不要試著自己處理。
in case of need: There is extra water in the back of the bus in case of need, so tell the driver if you are thirsty.
公車後面有多準備的水以備需要，所以如果你口渴就告訴司機。
in case of doubt: In case of doubt about the homework, you can send a message to Ms. Lin, and she will answer you tonight.
如對作業有疑問，你可以傳訊息給林老師，她今晚會回答你。
in case of bad weather: The school will cancel the picnic in case of bad weather, and we will watch a movie in the hall instead.
如遇壞天氣，學校會取消野餐，我們會改在大廳看電影。
in case of + 名詞 vs. in case + 子句: In case of fire, use the stairs, and in case the lights go out, follow the green signs to the exit.
如果發生火災請走樓梯，而如果燈熄了，就跟著綠色標示走到出口。
in case of rain vs. in case it rains: Bring a raincoat in case of rain, or just stay home in case it rains hard all afternoon tomorrow.
帶件雨衣以防下雨，或者如果明天整個下午下大雨，就乾脆待在家裡。
in case (以防) vs. if (如果): Take some money in case you get hungry, and if the store is closed, you can buy food on the train.
帶些錢以防你餓了，而如果商店關了，你可以在火車上買食物。
The sky looks gray this morning, so take an umbrella in case, even if the weather report says it will not rain.
今天早上天空看起來灰灰的，所以帶把傘以防萬一，即使天氣預報說不會下雨。
in any case: The bus might be late, but in any case, we will still get to the museum before it opens at nine.
公車可能會晚到，但無論如何，我們還是會在博物館九點開門之前到達。
in this case: Peter has a fever today, and in this case, he should stay home and rest instead of going to practice.
彼得今天發燒了，在這個情況下，他應該待在家裡休息，而不是去練習。
in no case: You should in no case open the door to a stranger when you are home alone, even if he seems friendly.
當你獨自在家時，絕不可以為陌生人開門，即使他看起來很友善。
be in charge of the class: Ms. Chen is in charge of the class this year, and she wants every student to arrive before eight o'clock.
陳老師今年負責這個班，她希望每位學生都在八點前到校。
be in charge of the shop: My aunt is in charge of the shop when the owner is away, so she has to count the money every night.
老闆不在時，我阿姨負責這家店，所以她每晚都得算錢。
the person in charge: If your food is cold, please ask for the person in charge, and he will bring you a new dish.
如果你的食物冷了，請找負責人，他會為你送上一份新的菜。
take charge of: When our coach got sick, the captain took charge of the team and led us to practice every afternoon.
我們的教練生病時，隊長接管了球隊，每天下午帶我們練習。
in charge of cooking: Dad is in charge of cooking on weekends, and his beef noodles are the best thing in our house.
爸爸週末負責煮飯，他的牛肉麵是我們家最棒的東西。
The little puppy was left in the charge of my brother for a week, and he gave it food three times a day.
這隻小狗由我哥哥負責照顧一個星期，他每天餵它三次。
be in charge: Amy asked who was in charge because the music was too loud and the kids could not hear the teacher.
艾咪問誰在負責，因為音樂太大聲了，孩子們聽不到老師說話。
put sb. in charge: The teacher put Jenny in charge of the class party, so she made a list of food and games for everyone.
老師讓珍妮負責班級派對，所以她為大家列了一張食物和遊戲的清單。
free of charge: Children under six can get in the zoo free of charge, but their parents have to buy a ticket at the gate.
六歲以下的孩童可以免費進動物園，但他們的父母必須在門口買票。
charge for: The shop charges for paper bags now, so remember to bring your own bag when you go shopping there.
這家店現在紙袋要收費，所以去那裡購物時記得帶自己的袋子。
close to the station: The new bookstore is close to the station, so I can buy a book and catch my train in five minutes.
新書店靠近車站，所以我可以在五分鐘內買本書然後趕上火車。
live close to school: Lucy lives close to school, so she can walk there in three minutes and never worries about being late.
露西住在學校附近，所以她三分鐘就能走到學校，從不擔心遲到。
sit close to the fire: It was cold at the camp that night, so we sat close to the fire and told stories until midnight.
那晚營地很冷，所以我們靠近火坐著，講故事講到半夜。
close to the sea: My grandmother lives in a small house close to the sea, and I love hearing the waves at night.
我奶奶住在靠海的一間小房子裡，我喜歡在夜裡聽海浪的聲音。
stand close to me: Stand close to me when we cross the busy street, because many cars and scooters do not stop here.
我們過這條繁忙的街時，站在我附近，因為很多汽車和機車在這裡不會停。
close to each other: The two kittens slept close to each other in the box to stay warm on the cold winter night.
在寒冷的冬夜，兩隻小貓在箱子裡彼此靠近地睡著，好保持溫暖。
close to the top: We are close to the top of the mountain, so let's rest for ten minutes and then finish the climb.
我們已經接近山頂了，所以休息十分鐘，然後完成最後的攀登吧。
close to home: The story about the sick dog hit close to home for Amy, because her own dog died last winter.
那個關於生病小狗的故事對艾咪來說切中要害，因為她自己的狗去年冬天過世了。
close to 100 people: Close to 100 people came to the school show on Friday night, so we had to bring more chairs from the gym.
星期五晚上接近一百人來看學校的表演，所以我們得從體育館搬更多椅子來。
close to midnight: It was close to midnight when the party ended, so my father drove over to pick us up from Tom's house.
派對結束時已接近午夜，所以我爸爸開車到湯姆家來接我們。
be close to tears: Mary was close to tears when she lost her grandmother's necklace, but her brother found it under the sofa.
瑪麗弄丟奶奶的項鍊時快要哭了，但她哥哥在沙發下找到了它。
be close to giving up: Jack was close to giving up on the math problem, but his sister showed him an easy way to solve it.
傑克快要放棄那道數學題了，但他姐姐教他一個簡單的解法。
I am very close to my cousin Ivy, and we tell each other everything, even our biggest secrets.
我和表姐艾薇非常親近，我們什麼都告訴對方，連最大的秘密也說。
close to the truth: The police officer felt the boy's story was close to the truth, but he still asked a few more questions.
警察覺得男孩的說法接近事實，但他仍然多問了幾個問題。
come close to winning: Our team came close to winning the game, but the other side scored in the last ten seconds.
我們的隊伍差一點就贏了比賽，但對方在最後十秒得分。
close to one's heart: The old park is close to my heart because my grandfather took me there to fly kites every Sunday.
這座老公園對我很重要，因為爺爺以前每個星期天都帶我去那裡放風箏。
a close friend: Tina is a close friend of mine, and we have sat together in class since the first grade.
蒂娜是我的密友，我們從一年級開始就在班上坐在一起。
close up: The picture looked beautiful from far away, but close up you could see many small mistakes in the colors.
這幅畫從遠處看很美，但近看你會發現顏色上有許多小錯誤。
close at hand: Keep your pen and notebook close at hand during the talk, because the speaker will say many useful things.
演講時把筆和筆記本放在近在手邊的地方，因為講者會說很多有用的東西。
be close to death: The old man was close to death after the accident, but the doctors worked all night and saved his life.
那位老人在意外後瀕臨死亡，但醫生們工作了整夜，救回了他的命。
close to (接近, 需 to) vs. near (不需 to): The post office is close to the park, and the bank is near the park too, so you can walk to both.
郵局靠近公園，銀行也在公園附近，所以你可以走路到這兩個地方。
close to the school: My house is close to the school and near the park, so I can walk to both places in a few minutes.
我家靠近學校，也在公園附近，所以我幾分鐘內就能走到這兩個地方。
close (靠近, 形／副) vs. close (關, 動詞): Sit close to the heater, and please close the door so the warm air stays inside the room.
坐靠近暖氣一點，並請把門關上，這樣暖空氣才會留在房間裡。
close to vs. next to (緊鄰): The library is close to our school, and the bookstore is right next to it, so we often visit both after class.
圖書館靠近我們學校，書店就緊鄰在它旁邊，所以我們下課後常常兩個地方都去。
closely (仔細地) vs. close (靠近): Look closely at the map, and you will see that the hotel is close to the night market and the river.
仔細地看地圖，你會發現飯店靠近夜市和河邊。
close to vs. almost (幾乎): It is close to nine now, and almost everyone has gone home, so let's turn off the lights and leave.
現在接近九點了，幾乎每個人都回家了，所以我們把燈關掉離開吧。
as to the price: As to the price, the manager said we could pay less if we bought five tickets together for the show.
關於價格，經理說如果我們一起買五張表演的票，可以付少一點。
as to what to do: Our teacher gave us no clear answer as to what to do next, so we just waited quietly in our seats.
至於接下來該做什麼，老師沒有給我們明確的答案，所以我們只是安靜地坐在座位上等。
as to the time: As to the time of the meeting, nobody is sure yet, but it will probably be on Friday after school.
關於會議的時間，還沒有人確定，但大概會是星期五放學後。
as to how: Linda knows she wants to open a bakery, but as to how she will get the money, she has no idea.
琳達知道她想開一家麵包店，但至於如何籌到錢，她毫無頭緒。
as to the reason: Kevin did not come to practice today, and as to the reason, nobody on the team knows anything at all.
凱文今天沒來練習，至於原因，隊上沒有人知道任何事。
a question as to: Many students have a question as to whether the test on Monday will cover the last two lessons too.
許多學生有個關於星期一的考試是否也包含最後兩課的疑問。
be at a loss as to: When the bus did not come, the visitors were at a loss as to how to get back to their hotel.
公車沒來時，遊客們對於要如何回到飯店感到不知所措。
up to 100 people: The small restaurant can hold up to 100 people, so it is a good place for our class party next month.
這家小餐廳最多可以容納一百人，所以是我們下個月班級派對的好地點。
up to ten years: A well-made bike can last up to ten years if you clean it often and keep it out of the rain.
一輛做得好的腳踏車，如果你常清潔並且不讓它淋雨，可以用長達十年。
be up to no good: The two boys were talking quietly behind the tree, and I knew they were up to no good from their smiles.
那兩個男孩在樹後面小聲說話，從他們的笑容我就知道他們沒幹好事。
What are you up to?: What are you up to this weekend, and would you like to join us for a picnic in the park near the river?
你這個週末在做什麼？要不要跟我們一起去河邊的公園野餐？
be up to the job: The new worker is young, but she is up to the job, and she finishes every order before the shop closes.
這位新員工很年輕，但她勝任這份工作，而且在店關門前完成每一份訂單。
up to the end: The movie was long, but we stayed up to the end because we wanted to know who stole the gold.
電影很長，但我們一直看到最後，因為我們想知道是誰偷了黃金。
up to my neck in work: My father is up to his neck in work this week, so he comes home after we are already asleep.
我爸爸這星期工作忙得不可開交，所以他回家時我們都已經睡著了。
live up to one's name: The restaurant called Happy Garden lives up to its name, because everyone there smiles and the food is great.
這家叫做快樂花園的餐廳名副其實，因為那裡每個人都在微笑，而且食物很棒。
feel up to doing: I do not feel up to playing basketball today because I have a headache and I slept badly last night.
我今天沒有精神打籃球，因為我頭痛，而且昨晚睡得不好。
be up to sb. to decide: It is up to you to decide which movie we watch tonight, but please choose one that is not too long.
今晚看哪部電影由你決定，但請選一部不要太長的。
up to and including: The sale lasts up to and including Sunday, so you still have three days to buy the shoes you want.
特賣會持續到星期日並包括當天，所以你還有三天可以買你想要的鞋子。
up to the minute: This news channel gives you up to the minute reports about the typhoon, so watch it before you leave home.
這個新聞頻道提供最新的颱風報導，所以出門前先看一下。
A little girl walked up to me in the park and asked if I had seen her small brown dog.
一個小女孩在公園裡走向我，問我有沒有看到她的小棕狗。
come up to me: The teacher came up to me after class and said my English speech was the best in the whole school.
下課後老師走過來我這裡，說我的英文演講是全校最好的。
go up to the top: We went up to the top of the tower by the stairs, and from there we could see the whole city.
我們走樓梯上到塔的頂端，從那裡可以看到整座城市。
up to a point: I agree with you up to a point, but I still think we should ask the teacher before we change the plan.
某種程度上我同意你，但我還是認為我們改變計畫之前應該先問老師。
up to one's old tricks: My little brother is up to his old tricks again, hiding my shoes before school so that I will be late.
我的小弟弟又耍老把戲了，上學前把我的鞋子藏起來，好讓我遲到。
It's up to you. vs. What are you up to?: Dinner is up to you tonight, so tell me what you are up to in the kitchen before you start cooking.
今晚的晚餐由你決定，所以在開始煮之前先告訴我你在廚房裡要幹什麼。
up to (最多) vs. at least (至少): The gym can take up to fifty people, but we need at least twenty to start the dance class this term.
體育館最多可以容納五十人，但這學期我們至少需要二十人才能開舞蹈課。
live up to (不負) vs. live on (靠…生活): Jenny lived up to her name as the fastest runner in school, though she lives on noodles and tea.
珍妮不負她全校跑最快的名聲，雖然她靠麵和茶維生。
be up to (勝任) vs. be able to: Mark is up to the job of class leader, and he is also able to help slow students with their math.
馬克勝任班長的工作，而且他也能夠幫助進度慢的同學學數學。
inside of a week: The doctor says my leg will be fine inside of a week, so I can play soccer again next Sunday.
醫生說我的腿一週內就會好，所以下星期天我又可以踢足球了。
inside of the box: There is a red bike inside of the box, and it is a birthday gift for my little brother.
盒子裡面有一輛紅色腳踏車，那是給我小弟弟的生日禮物。
the inside of the house: The inside of the house was dark and dirty, but after we washed the floor and walls, it looked bright and new.
房子的內部又暗又髒，但我們洗過地板和牆壁之後，它看起來明亮又嶄新。
inside of me: Inside of me, I knew the answer was wrong, but I was too shy to say anything in front of the class.
在我內心，我知道答案是錯的，但我太害羞了，不敢在全班面前說什麼。
inside of a year: My cousin learned to speak good Japanese inside of a year because she practiced with her friends from Japan every day.
我表姐在一年內就學會說流利的日文，因為她每天和日本朋友練習。
inside of (美式口語): Americans often say the cat is inside of the house, but in writing it is better to say inside the house.
美國人常口語說貓在房子裡面 inside of，但書寫時最好說 inside the house。
inside (介係詞) vs. inside of (口語): The keys are inside the drawer, or as my American friend says, they are inside of the drawer by the door.
鑰匙在抽屜裡面，或者像我的美國朋友口語說的，在門邊的抽屜裡面。
inside out (裡外翻) vs. upside down (上下顛倒): Tom put his T-shirt on inside out, and he even hung the picture upside down on the wall.
湯姆把T恤裡外翻著穿，甚至還把畫上下顛倒地掛在牆上。
except for a few mistakes: Except for a few mistakes in spelling, your English letter was very good, and I enjoyed reading it.
除了幾個拼字錯誤，你的英文信寫得很好，我讀得很開心。
except for Tom: Except for Tom, everyone in our class went on the trip to the mountains, because he had a bad cold.
除了湯姆，我們班每個人都去了山上旅行，因為他得了重感冒。
except for the price: The new phone is perfect except for the price, which is much higher than most students can pay.
這支新手機除了價格之外很完美，它的價格比大多數學生能付的高太多了。
except for one thing: I like my new school except for one thing, and that is the cold lunch they serve every day.
除了一件事之外我喜歡我的新學校，那就是他們每天供應的冷午餐。
except for that: The hotel room was small, but except for that, our trip to Japan was wonderful from start to finish.
飯店房間很小，但除了那個之外，我們的日本之旅從頭到尾都很棒。
except for the noise: Except for the noise from the street, the apartment is a nice place to live, and the rent is low.
除了街上的噪音，這間公寓是個很好的住處，而且租金很低。
except for me: Everyone in my family can swim well except for me, so I am taking lessons at the pool this summer.
我家每個人都很會游泳，除了我，所以我今年夏天在游泳池上課。
except for (整體中例外, 可句首) vs. except (同類排除: Except for the rain on the first day, the trip was perfect, and we visited every place except the museum.
除了第一天下雨（整體中的例外），這次旅行很完美，我們參觀了除了博物館之外的每個地方。
Except for Tom, we all came to the party on time, and he finally arrived after the cake was gone.
除了湯姆，我們都準時來參加派對，而他在蛋糕吃完後才終於到。
all days except Sunday: The shop opens all days except Sunday, and except for the holidays, it closes at nine every night.
這家店除了星期日每天都開，而且除了假日之外，每晚九點關門。
except for: Except for the cold weather, I enjoyed the trip, and apart from a little rain, every day was sunny.
除了天氣冷之外，我很享受這次旅行，而且除了一點小雨，每天都是晴天。
except for vs. besides (包含): Except for Amy, no one brought a camera, but besides her camera, she also brought a map of the island.
除了艾咪之外沒有人帶相機，但除了相機以外，她還帶了一張島上的地圖。
but for (要不是) vs. except for (除了): Except for the ending, I liked the movie, and but for your help with the tickets, I could not have seen it.
除了結局之外我喜歡這部電影，而要不是你幫我買票，我根本看不到。
out of the room: The teacher asked Jack to go out of the room because he kept talking and laughing during the test.
老師要傑克離開房間，因為他在考試時一直講話和笑。
out of the house: We were out of the house by seven this morning because we wanted to catch the first train to Taipei.
我們今天早上七點前就出了屋子，因為我們想趕上去臺北的第一班火車。
out of the car: Please do not get out of the car until it stops, because the road is busy and very dangerous here.
請等車停了再下車，因為這裡的路很繁忙而且非常危險。
out of school: When the kids get out of school at four, they usually buy a snack from the vendor near the gate.
孩子們四點放學後，通常會向校門附近的小販買點心。
out of bed: It is hard for me to get out of bed on cold winter mornings, so my mother has to call me three times.
在寒冷的冬天早晨我很難起床，所以媽媽得叫我三次。
out of hospital: My grandfather came out of hospital yesterday, and the doctor told him to rest and walk a little every day.
我爺爺昨天出院了，醫生要他休息，並且每天走一點路。
out of the country: My father is out of the country on business this week, so he will miss my birthday party on Saturday.
我爸爸這星期出國洽公，所以他會錯過我星期六的生日派對。
out of love: My mother gets up at five every day to make our breakfast out of love, not because she has to.
我媽媽每天五點起床為我們做早餐，是出於愛，而不是因為她必須這麼做。
out of anger: Ben threw his book across the room out of anger, but later he felt sorry and said so to his mother.
班出於憤怒把書丟到房間另一頭，但後來他覺得抱歉，並向媽媽道了歉。
nine times out of ten: Nine times out of ten, my dog waits by the door at six because he knows I will come home then.
十之八九，我的狗六點會在門邊等著，因為它知道我那時會回家。
made out of wood: This cute little boat is made out of wood, and my grandfather built it with his own hands many years ago.
這艘可愛的小船是用木頭做的，是我爺爺很多年前親手造的。
keep out of trouble: Our teacher told us to keep out of trouble during the trip and to stay with our group at all times.
老師告訴我們旅行期間別惹麻煩，並且隨時和自己的小組待在一起。
stay out of it: When my two sisters argue about the TV, I stay out of it and read a book in my room instead.
當我的兩個姐姐為了電視吵架時，我不插手，改在房間裡看書。
talk sb. out of: Mary wanted to quit the swimming team, but her coach talked her out of it and she won a race later.
瑪麗想退出游泳隊，但教練說服她不要這麼做，後來她還贏了一場比賽。
grow out of: My little brother grew out of his shoes in just six months, so Mom had to buy him a bigger pair.
我的小弟弟才六個月就長大到穿不下他的鞋子，所以媽媽得買一雙更大的給他。
be out of one's mind: You must be out of your mind to swim in the sea during a typhoon; the waves could carry you away.
你一定是瘋了才會在颱風時到海裡游泳；海浪可能會把你捲走。
out of the ordinary: Nothing out of the ordinary happened at school today, but I still had fun playing basketball with my friends.
今天學校沒發生什麼不尋常的事，但我和朋友打籃球還是玩得很開心。
out of the corner of one's eye: Out of the corner of my eye, I saw a cat jump on the kitchen table and steal a piece of fish.
我用眼角餘光看到一隻貓跳上廚房的桌子，偷了一塊魚。
out of thin air: The magician made a white rabbit appear out of thin air, and all the children in the park cheered loudly.
魔術師無中生有變出一隻白兔，公園裡所有的孩子都大聲歡呼。
out of touch: I have been out of touch with my old friends since we moved to Tainan, but I still think about them.
自從我們搬到臺南後，我就和老朋友失去聯絡了，但我仍然想著他們。
out of season: Strawberries are out of season in summer, so they cost a lot more than they do in the winter months.
草莓在夏天非當季，所以價格比冬天的月份貴很多。
out of character: It was out of character for quiet Tom to tell jokes in class, so everyone looked at him in surprise.
安靜的湯姆在課堂上講笑話，很不像他平常的作風，所以每個人都驚訝地看著他。
out of hand: The party got out of hand when fifty people showed up, so the neighbors called the police after midnight.
五十個人出現時派對失控了，所以鄰居在午夜過後打電話叫警察。
out of bounds: The ball went out of bounds, so the other team got it and scored a point in the last minute.
球越界了，所以另一隊拿到球，並在最後一分鐘得了一分。
out of pocket: I paid for the broken window out of pocket because I did not want my parents to know about it.
我自掏腰包賠了那扇破窗，因為我不想讓父母知道這件事。
out of this world: The chocolate cake at that new bakery is out of this world, so we bought three pieces for the whole family.
那家新麵包店的巧克力蛋糕太棒了，所以我們買了三塊給全家人吃。
out of the woods: My grandmother is feeling better after the operation, but the doctor says she is not out of the woods yet.
我奶奶手術後感覺好一些了，但醫生說她還沒脫離險境。
out of the running: After Tom hurt his ankle in the first race, he was out of the running for the final prize.
湯姆在第一場比賽弄傷腳踝之後，就沒機會爭取最後的大獎了。
out of favor: That old pop song is out of favor with teenagers now, but my parents still love to sing it at parties.
那首老流行歌現在在青少年之間失寵了，但我父母仍然喜歡在派對上唱它。
out of focus: The photo of my cat is out of focus because I moved the camera when I pushed the button.
我那張貓的照片失焦了，因為我按下按鈕時移動了相機。
out of step: My grandfather's ideas about phones are out of step with the times, and he still thinks kids should write letters.
我爺爺對手機的想法和時代不一致，他仍然認為孩子應該寫信。
out of line: It was out of line for Jack to shout at the waiter, so his mother asked him to say sorry at once.
傑克對服務生大吼實在太過分了，所以他媽媽要他立刻道歉。
out of turn: Please do not speak out of turn in class; wait until the teacher calls your name and then give your answer.
請不要在課堂上不按順序發言；等老師叫到你的名字再回答。
out of interest: Out of interest, Lily asked the old farmer how many years he had worked on the land near the river.
出於興趣，莉莉問那位老農夫在河邊那片土地上工作了多少年。
out of the way (偏遠): My uncle lives in an out of the way village in the mountains, so we visit him only once a year.
我叔叔住在山裡一個偏遠的村子，所以我們一年只去看他一次。
out of a job: Mr. Wang has been out of a job since the factory closed, so his family is careful with money now.
自從工廠關閉後王先生就失業了，所以他家現在用錢很小心。
out of gas: Our car ran out of gas on the highway, so we had to walk two kilometers to the nearest gas station.
我們的車在高速公路上沒油了，所以我們得走兩公里到最近的加油站。
out of use: The old train station has been out of use for ten years, and grass now grows between the tracks.
這座老火車站已經十年不再使用了，現在鐵軌之間長出了草。
out of sorts: Amy felt out of sorts this morning, so she did not eat breakfast and stayed in bed until almost noon.
艾咪今天早上覺得不舒服、心情不好，所以她沒吃早餐，一直躺在床上到快中午。
out of (離開內部) vs. off (離開表面) vs. from (來: Lily got out of the car, took her hat off the seat, and read a letter from her grandmother.
莉莉從車裡出來，從座位上拿起帽子，然後讀了一封來自奶奶的信。
out of (原因) vs. for (目的): She helped the old man out of love, not for money, and he thanked her with a warm smile.
她出於愛心幫助那位老人，不是為了錢，而他用溫暖的微笑感謝她。
made out of: This chair is made out of old wood, and the table next to it is made of the same wood.
這張椅子是用舊木頭製成的，旁邊的桌子也是用同樣的木頭製成的。
out of (比例) vs. of: Three out of ten students in our class wear glasses, and most of them are good friends of mine.
我們班十分之三的學生戴眼鏡，而他們當中大多數是我的好朋友。
three out of ten vs. three of them: Three out of ten kids in the park had ice cream, and three of them shared theirs with their little sisters.
公園裡十個孩子中有三個吃冰淇淋，而他們當中有三個和小妹妹分享。
out of work (失業) vs. off work (下班) vs. a: My uncle was out of work for a year, but now he is at work every day and is off work by six.
我叔叔失業了一年，但現在他每天都在工作，而且六點前就下班。
out of (介係詞) vs. out (副詞): Jack ran out of the room to get his bag, and then he went out again to play with his dog.
傑克跑出房間去拿他的書包，然後又出去和他的狗玩。
look out of the window (非 look out the w: On rainy days, I like to look out of the window and watch people walk by with their colorful umbrellas.
下雨天我喜歡看窗外，看人們拿著五顏六色的雨傘走過。
out of the question (不可能) vs. out of que: Going to the party on a school night is out of the question, so stop asking and finish your homework now.
上學日的晚上去派對是不可能的，所以別再問了，現在就把作業寫完。
